data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding increased during 2020 (opening gross reserves GBP 1,051.0m). Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year gross deterioration of approximately GBP 46.5m (4.4% of opening gross reserves), driven by upward re-estimates in several prior underwriting years (notably 2016-2018 changes). The managing agent reports a net favourable prior-year development of GBP 6.6m (2019: adverse GBP 37.9m) after reinsurance; this divergence is attributable to increased reinsurance recoveries during the year (including a purchased Adverse Development Cover protecting casualty classes for 2017 and prior) which improved the net position despite gross strengthening on some years. Weather-related large loss events (including Hurricane Laura and Hurricane Sally and prior PCS 2016 wind events) and COVID-19 pandemic effects are cited as primary influences on reserve movements.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (see notes) because no single explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' figure was presented. The managing agent narrative reports a net favourable prior-year development of GBP 6.6m (net of reinsurance); that figure is NET and differs from the gross triangle-based calculation (gross strengthening ~GBP 46.5m) because of increased reinsurance recoveries (including a purchased Adverse Development Cover). The 'Earlier' aggregate column was excluded from triangle calculations per methodology rules. No RITC distortion other than the Part VII transfer (small) was identified; the purchase of the Adverse Development Cover materially affects net results.
